newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Surgutneftegaz to consider bonus shares June 30.
newsitem.headline: Surgutneftegaz to consider bonus shares June 30.

text.p: Russian oil production company AO Surgutneftegaz will consider increasing capital by 21.70 billion ordinary shares and 6.45 billion preferred shares at a shareholder meeting on June 30, the company said on Tuesday.

The shares then would be issued free to shareholders at the discretion of the board of directors, a spokesman said. Surgutneftegaz currently has 4.62 billion ordinaries and 1.37 billion prefs, though the spokesman was unable to say whether that included 166 million preferred shares authorised in March.
Shares of Surgutneftegaz, which is Russia's third largest oil producer and located in Western Siberia, have a nominal value of 1,000 roubles.
Ordinary shares had not traded on the Russian Trading System on Tuesday after Monday's $0.860 close. Prefs SNGS_p.RTS had risen to $0.558 at 0740 GMT from $0.550 at Monday's close.
